name: express_entry_rounds
description: Rounds of invitations under Canada's Express Entry immigration system: draw number, date, program (e.g. Canadian Experience Class, Provincial Nominee Program, French language proficiency), invitations issued and the lowest CRS (Comprehensive Ranking System) score invited. Newest first. Pass draw_number for one round, or program / date range / limit to filter. Source: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada, Express Entry rounds of invitations.

program.description: Case-insensitive substring of the program name, e.g. "Canadian Experience"
